rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: US market closed (Sat/holiday-adjacent weekend) — spot crypto only. Tape is neutral-to-cautious: BTC ~$62.6k (+0.45% 24h), ETH +0.62%, while SOL just FAILED its $80 breakout and rolled back to $80.5 (-2.5% 24h). No fresh asymmetric catalyst across majors; institutional flows steady but no new driver.
positions.driver: Low-edge weekend — rule says park in the lowest-vol/spot option with the most downside protection. Among liquid majors BTC has the lowest realized vol, the deepest weekend liquidity, and is the only major mildly green on the day. Unleveraged spot caps drawdown to BTC's own (modest) vol; tighter 8% stop chosen (vs 10% spot default) precisely because BTC's daily range is small, tightening downside protection without whipsaw risk.
positions.risks: Thin-weekend liquidity flush or a BTC break of its $62k base would drag the whole complex; being long BTC forgoes upside if SOL/ETH mean-revert higher. But on a no-catalyst weekend, capital preservation > chasing the highest-beta name that just failed a breakout. 8% stop ($57,630) bounds the downside.
